Sub: Lists of the Candidates found not eligible for the post of Laboratory Technician, Laboratory Assistant, Junior Clerk cum Data Entry Operator and Assistant Store Keeper.
With reference to the Notification No. C/Gen/1258 dated 05/05/2023 published in newspaper “The Hitavada” dated 09/05/2023, applications received for the post of Laboratory Technician, Laboratory Assistant, Junior Clerk cum Data Entry Operator and Assistant Store Keeper have been scrutinized.
Basis on the recommendation of the Scrutiny Committee, following applicants have been found to be not eligible in accordance with the eligibility criteria as mentioned in the advertisement.
List of rejected candidates for the post of Laboratory Technician, Laboratory Assistant, Junior Clerk cum Data Entry Operator and Assistant Store Keeper.
In case any of the applicants are not satisfied with the reasons for ineligibility he / she may submit his / her representation supported by documentary evidence. No representation without supporting documents will be entertained. The said representation along with scanned copy of documents should be emailed to
deanoffice@mgims.ac.in
by 14/06/2023 and no representation thereafter will be entertained.
Candidates are requested to mention the subject of the e-mail as “Rejection of Application for the post of (__________), Name of the Applicant (__________).
Dean
Note :
The
applicants found eligible shall be informed on the college website
for written examination shortly as well as through email.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
